name: Recall
description: Create and manage spaced repetition flashcard decks in Recall directly from Claude. Turn lecture notes, articles, or any conversation into rich cards in one request — Claude designs the deck structure, writes atomic cards that follow proven memory-retention principles, and schedules them so you can start reviewing right away. Track your progress and surface your most difficult cards anytime.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Recall to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Recall to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.recall.cards/v1/mcp/claude.

_published_faq.name: Is Recall MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Recall scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Recall MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Recall lists 31 MCP tools, including activate_card_layout, add_card_layout_fields, add_cards, add_deck_fields, copy_deck, create_card_layout, create_deck, deactivate_card_layout, delete_card_layout, delete_cards, delete_deck_field, and generate_deck_field_values.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Recall?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Recall in education on the Manufact MCP catalog include DocCheck Flexikon, Vocaneo, Grammaropolis, TheWholeTorah, and Fryd - Your Gardening Companion.
Recall does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: Why is Recall failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Recall scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is MCP negotiation succeeds (v1/v2). Failed to connect: Authentication required Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
Recall is developed by Recall. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
